title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
contentSnippet: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
contentSnippet: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
contentSnippet: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
contentSnippet: Almost 100,000 Commerce.com domains now give AI agents real shopping tools through WebMCP on Cloudflare. Here's how we turned it on across every store at once, while keeping each merchant in control.

title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
contentSnippet: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
contentSnippet: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
contentSnippet: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
contentSnippet: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next.

title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services
contentSnippet: Try Amazon ECS Gateway, a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.

title: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity
contentSnippet:
Three Java Champions share how they use GitHub Copilot to solve problems, accelerate development, and keep humans responsible for the results.
